messages:
maria: Heads-up: A subset of embedding customers are seeing elevated latency and some similarity scores look off. Engineering flagged a recent cache feature-flag as the likely trigger. Need coordinated comms: statuspage language, what to tell webinar registrants, and lead intake gating. Thoughts?

lucas: Confirmed by infra — enabling the cache FF caused inconsistent KV hits. Rolling the flag back now; estimate 30	60m to validate. We'll post progress updates.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-embeddings-cache-issue created by lucas.

priya: Priority: update statuspage to explain impact without scaring non-technical customers. Also short note to webinar registrants (no deep technical detail). Hold any broad product launch/benchmark posts until we've fully validated.

sam: Sales request: throttle marketing -> SFDC pipeline pushes. Route new trials to incident-team-inbox@redwood.com and mute automation that opens new outreach tasks for 2 hours. We don't want SDRs pinging customers about demos that might be impacted.

jasmin: For statuspage copy proposal: keep it concise, clear mitigation steps, and ETA for next update. Example: 

jasmin: ```
We are investigating degraded performance for certain embedding and similarity requests. Impact: some requests may experience higher latency and results may be temporarily less accurate.
What we're doing: disabling a recent cache optimization and re-routing traffic to the stable path while we validate results.
Next update: 30 minutes. If you run time-sensitive production jobs, contact support@redwood.com with your account and job IDs for priority handling.
```

maria: Nicely put. Add a single-line note for registrants: we should not push webinar content that depends on live embeddings (e.g., similarity demos).

priya: Draft registrant DM: "Quick update: we've paused live demo segments that use real-time embeddings due to a platform incident. We'll update registrants via email within 48 hours and link to status.redwood.com for live updates."

sam: I'll flip the SFDC webhook to incident-inbound mailbox and pause outbound lead automation. Once that's done I'll post confirmation.

lucas: Ops: planning to publish the first public status entry in ~20	60 minutes after the rollback starts and metrics show improved 95th percentile latency.

jasmin: Also recommend pausing any benchmark tweets/posts and landing page live updates. Replace those with a short banner: "Temporarily pausing scheduled demo/benchmark posts due to platform maintenance" so no one sees inconsistent numbers.

incident-bot: SFDC webhook switched to incident-team-inbox@redwood.com by automation.

priya: For enterprise/dedicated customers: send targeted note via account team with a slightly higher detail level and offer a quick call. Tag those tickets as "incident-priority".

maria: Agree. Also disable paid channels (ad campaigns + boosted posts) until we mark the incident resolved. We'll resume once metrics are green for 2 consecutive cycles.

sam: Done: paused outbound automation and confirmed the incident mailbox is live. SDRs will monitor but not engage unless a customer explicitly requests immediate contact.

lucas: Update @30m: rollback completed, running validation. If we hit expected thresholds I'll ask for a statuspage "recovering" update.

maria: Thanks everyone. Action items: jasmin publish statuspage draft when I give the go, priya send registrant DM now, sam confirm SFDC pause (done), lucas post recovery update. Keep updates short here. :pray:
